label: FINAL FANTASY VII
stylePrompt: Create ONE finished narrative fantasy painting for the Kalistar x Final Fantasy VII card collection. Reference 1 is the APPROVED Cloud painting: match its confident brushwork, painted planes, worn materials, expressive character, motivated light and cinematic storytelling. Reference 2 is Momo, the underlying Kalistar identity. References are STYLE ONLY: do not include Cloud or Momo. NOT a photograph, NOT glossy 3D game render, NOT anime, NOT manga. Rich nuanced pigments and visible purposeful painted strokes, never a uniform noise filter. Clear character silhouette and personal emotion, restrained readable background. Portrait 4:5 composition, whole main gesture and weapon inside the central 75% width; face above center; enough room below hands. No card frame, text, numbers, watermark, logo or graphic interface. Maintain the named FF7 character's original recognizable anatomy and outfit; Red XIII and Cait Sith are explicit nonhuman crossover exceptions to Kalistar's usual humanoid rule.

cards.name: BARRET
cards.title: CEUX QUI RESTENT DEBOUT
cards.description: Sous les plaques de Midgar, Barret tient le passage. Le métal de son bras gronde, mais sa colère a un nom : ceux qu'il refuse de perdre. Derrière ce rempart, quelqu'un peut encore rentrer chez soi.
cards.scene: Barret Wallace, huge muscular middle-aged dark-skinned man with short black hair, rugged beard, small sunglasses pushed high enough to read his determined eyes, brown sleeveless utility vest and military trousers. His RIGHT forearm is a heavy mechanical rotary gun prosthesis, not a hand holding a gun; left arm is human. Low braced three-quarter stance holding a collapsing steel gate open with his left shoulder while keeping his gun arm aimed outward to shield the unseen people behind him. Emotion: fierce paternal protectiveness, strain and resolve, not a generic angry pose. Under a Midgar plate, a few huge readable industrial beams, wet ground and amber light through smoke, limited background clutter. Very subtle ochre stone energy around his boots fits Earth magic, gun and face remain dominant.

cards.name: TIFA
cards.title: NE JAMAIS LÂCHER PRISE
cards.description: La pluie efface le sang de ses gants, pas sa détermination. Tifa reprend appui et se relève. Elle n'a pas besoin de promettre la victoire : son poing dit déjà qu'elle ne laissera personne derrière.
cards.scene: Tifa Lockhart, adult athletic woman with very long straight black hair and recognizable white athletic tank top, black functional skirt-shorts, suspenders, red fighting gloves and red boots. Strong natural martial-arts action, advancing a grounded punch while her other hand protects her chin, weight and anatomy credible. Expression: exhausted but fiercely hopeful, a small abrasion on cheek; looking at her opponent beyond the painting. Rainy Midgar rooftop after a storm, water splashing naturally around one grounded foot and a restrained ribbon of water following the striking glove. No pin-up pose, no sexualized framing, no exaggerated anatomy. Warm window light contrasts with clean turquoise storm sky, only a few quiet roof shapes behind.

cards.name: AERIS
cards.title: UNE FLEUR DANS LES RUINES
cards.description: Au milieu de l'église brisée, Aeris écoute ce que les autres n'entendent plus. Une fleur tient entre ses doigts. Tant qu'une lumière répond sous les décombres, aucun destin n'est tout à fait refermé.
cards.scene: Aerith Gainsborough (Aeris), recognizable adult woman with warm green eyes, long brown braid tied by a pink ribbon, cropped red jacket over her modest long pink dress, brown boots. In the ruined Sector 5 church, kneeling naturally beside a small patch of flowers; one hand holds her recognizable metal staff upright, the other carefully offers a single small yellow flower outward. Emotion: tender courage with a hint of sadness and a knowing restrained smile, never vacant model expression. A broken roof admits a warm white-gold shaft of light that softly answers from her hand; staff fully readable. Keep the flower bed modest and distant church arches quiet, airy painted background, no ornate clutter.

cards.name: RED XIII
cards.title: LE FEU DES ANCÊTRES
cards.description: Sur les hauteurs de Cosmo Canyon, Nanaki cesse un instant de fuir son héritage. La braise au bout de sa queue répond aux étoiles. Il ne marche plus pour prouver sa force, mais pour veiller sur les siens.
cards.scene: Red XIII / Nanaki from FF7 in his ORIGINAL quadruped anatomy: one coherent lean muscular lion-like red-orange feline body with four paws, dark spiky mane, one scarred closed eye, intelligent expressive visible eye, recognizable simple tribal ornaments, a long tail ending in a small flame. NO human torso, no human hands, no weapon. On a broad sandstone ledge at Cosmo Canyon, turning his head back toward an unseen companion while bracing one forepaw, flame tail curves visibly beside him within composition. Emotion: proud watchfulness softened by vulnerability, an ancient soul finding belonging. Rust-red and gray canyon walls low in frame, expansive cobalt twilight and a few early stars, calm uncluttered sky. Luminous natural fire, not monstrous or snarling.

cards.name: CAIT SITH
cards.title: LE DERNIER COUP DE CHANCE
cards.description: Un rire, un pronostic impossible, puis Cait Sith s'interpose. Derrière le numéro et les coutures de sa monture, quelqu'un a choisi son camp. Ce soir, la chance ne servira pas seulement à gagner.
cards.scene: Cait Sith from FF7: small expressive black-and-white cat automaton with a little gold crown, red cape and boots, riding his iconic oversized round WHITE stuffed Mog robot. Both readable as ONE clear mounted pair, not multiple cats. Cat holds a small megaphone out in one paw as if loudly rallying friends, other paw clings to mount for balance. Mog planted protectively at an entrance, soft worn fabric and visible seams, no creepy doll effect. Cat has a mischievous warm smile with determined eyebrows, a lovable trickster making a brave decision. Gold Saucer after closing, just a few softly painted carnival lights and distant amusement architecture, cool moonlight. Small crystalline ice motes responding to the megaphone's call, not a snowstorm. Match adult painterly Kalistar art, not cartoons or plastic 3D.

cards.name: CID
cards.title: LE CIEL N'ATTEND PAS
cards.description: Le vent tire sur son écharpe tandis que le Highwind traverse les nuages. Cid serre sa lance et sourit enfin. Les rêves ont pris des coups, comme lui. Cela ne les empêche pas de repartir.
cards.scene: Cid Highwind from FF7, rugged blond middle-aged pilot with short tousled hair, light stubble, flight goggles on forehead, blue flight jacket, white scarf, practical flight trousers and gloves. On the Highwind airship deck, leaning into a strong gust, gripping a long metallic spear diagonally across his body with both hands, tip visible in upper part without leaving portrait, entirely different from a sword. His expression is a weathered confident half-smile and renewed excitement, dreamer under the gruff exterior. Scarf and coat react coherently to the wind. A low section of airship railing and machinery, mostly bright clean cloud sea and pale blue sky, restrained density, warm sunlight illuminating face. Painterly sweeping wind strokes, no wing appendages.

cards.name: VINCENT
cards.title: CE QUI VEILLE DANS L'OMBRE
cards.description: Vincent connaît le poids d'une porte que l'on ferme trop tard. Sous sa cape rouge, il garde le silence et reprend sa veille. Si le passé réclame encore une vie, cette fois il devra passer par lui.
cards.scene: Vincent Valentine from FF7, lean adult man with long black hair, pale angular face, red eyes, iconic tattered crimson high-collared cape over fitted black clothing, gold clawed LEFT gauntlet, recognizable long-barreled gun in his RIGHT normal gloved hand. Standing in a ruined Shinra Mansion doorway, half turning toward a sound, gun lowered diagonally but ready, gaze burdened yet protective rather than villainous. No vampire fangs, no gore, no superhero stance. Cape drapes with weight and wear, dark leather and scratched gold painted in tactile strokes. Quiet desaturated stone corridor with a single cold moonlit opening, controlled ruby magic glimmer along his gauntlet gives Hemato identity. Face, hand and gun clearly separate.

cards.name: YUFFIE
cards.title: POUR QUE WUTAI SE RELÈVE
cards.description: Yuffie prétend ne courir que pour la matéria. Pourtant, lorsqu'elle se retourne vers Wutai, son sourire change. L'étoile géante revient dans sa main : il reste un pays à relever, et elle compte bien commencer.
cards.scene: Yuffie Kisaragi from FF7, recognizable spirited young ninja with short dark hair, white forehead band, modest functional green high-neck sleeveless top, practical beige shorts, large protective shoulder/arm guard and ninja gloves. Age-appropriate nonsexual portrayal. Landing on one knee on a Wutai tiled rooftop after catching her iconic oversized four-point metal SHURIKEN, held low diagonally beside her so all four points read, not a sword or tiny throwing star. Her expression combines a cheeky triumphant grin with real fierce determination, action not modeling. A small scrape on elbow, wind in cropped hair. Subtle green leaf-energy trail follows shuriken. A few distant pagoda roof silhouettes and broad pale dawn sky, uncluttered background, no banners, no illegible text.

cards.name: SEPHIROTH
cards.title: L'OMBRE D'UNE PROMESSE
cards.description: Dans le silence qui suit les flammes, Sephiroth attend. Sa lame trace une frontière que nul n'ose franchir. Il protège ce qu'il nomme son destin, avec la même douceur terrible qu'il met à condamner le reste.
cards.scene: Sephiroth from FF7, tall adult man with extremely long silver hair, sharp controlled features, unsettling calm green eyes, iconic long black leather coat and silver pauldrons. Three-quarter standing stance blocking a ruined stone passage, his exceptionally long slender Masamune katana held with precise calm at a diagonal through the lower half; blade geometry straight, elegant, clearly visible within crop. Emotion: terrifying quiet conviction, composed charisma, not rage or exaggerated evil grin. A few distant embers of Nibelheim seen far behind, cool moonlight on silver hair and faint violet-black magic close to blade, subdued readable architecture. No gigantic wing, no throne, no baroque clutter. Painterly materials and facial expression exactly same family as approved Cloud.

arenas.prompt: Create ONE 16:9 wide landscape painting for an arena in Kalistar x Final Fantasy VII, in the painted narrative fantasy style of the supplied Cloud and Momo references: confident brush strokes, tactile weathered materials, nuanced color planes, NOT a screenshot, NOT photorealism or 3D. MIDGAR from FF7: a broad empty industrial transit forecourt beneath the massive city plate, readable rails and riveted bridges leading toward an iconic luminous green mako reactor, recognizable monumental Shinra industrial silhouette. Eye-level three-quarter perspective, strong deep sense of place, dark iron contrasted with emerald mako and warm small lamps, wet concrete reflections. Keep central foreground spacious and moderately quiet for the game board; frame the distance with machinery, not visual clutter everywhere. No characters, no combatants, no text, no logos, no interface, no card border. Dramatic but not underexposed; painting should be interesting by itself with legible architecture.

Create ONE 16:9 wide landscape painting for an arena in Kalistar x Final Fantasy VII, matching the supplied Cloud and Momo reference brushwork and painted materials, NOT photographic or 3D. COSMO CANYON from FF7 at sunset: broad accessible sandstone terrace in the foreground, majestic red and cool gray canyon walls beyond, a compact recognizable cliffside settlement built into the rock and the silhouette of its astronomical observatory on a high ledge, simple rope walkways, a small ceremonial fire offset to one side. Great open turquoise-to-indigo evening sky, warm sunset rocks and cool shadow planes, spiritual hopeful atmosphere, uncluttered yet genuinely specific to Cosmo Canyon. Central playable area broad and calm, structures toward sides and background, no floating platforms. No people, no animals, no readable text, no logos, no interface or card frame. Narrative painterly fantasy, nuanced colors and visible brush strokes.
